about_the_game:
Wota x Deduction x Training

This is a narrative-driven mystery adventure game with character training elements.

You will take on the role of the protagonist, Wada, steadily improving your abilities through daily part-time work, writing, watching idol performances, gaming and other pursuits. By deepening friendships with wota friends who have diverse attributes and gathering clues, uncover the truth behind a series of incidents in the idol wota world.

★Daily Life

Experience and plan daily schedules from the perspectives of three different identifies: a part-time pizza delivery man, a mystery novelist, and an idol wota. Develop ability improvement strategies within monthly time constraints to tackle diverse goals.

★Friendship

Each wota friends has their own unique wota attributes, and as their friendship with the protagonist deepens, they will provide clues corresponding to them. These clues will become pivotal to resolving various cases. Simultaneously, the individual stories of each friend will gradually unfold.

★Deduction

It's not just the main storyline; life will throw all sorts of troubles your way that need solving. But don't fret—you, our protagonist, are a brilliant mystery novelist (self-proclaimed). Though your novel sales aren't exactly booming, there's always a way, isn't there?

Features

  • Pixel art style

  • Rich character and narrative experience

  • Various game memes (?

  • Wota Life Simulation (x

Background, Characters and Story

"Leave, or you won't be able to leave next time."

★HSN57

The popular idol group enjoys immense popularity among wota in Hohsen, holding mini live concerts every month, which also become the stage for a series of incidents.

★Pizza Galaxy

A chain pizzeria known for delicious dipping sauces and fast delivery, where the protagonist works part-time as a delivery man.

★Amami's Mystery Labyrinth

The mystery novel written by the protagonist, serialized in the bimonthly magazine "Hohsen Literature", could scarcely provide enough manuscript fee to live on.

★Like a Wota Online

Commonly abbreviated as LAWO, is an online game that has suddenly become popular within the wota community.

It tells the story of a pilgrim overcoming relentless obstacles to journey thousands of miles to worship his god.

The reasoning behind the game's title is intriguing.

★Karl Wada (23)

The protagonist

His dream is to win the Mystery Writers Association Award and become a great mystery writer.

Yet before that, he had already become an idol wota of HSN57 and found himself entangled in a conspiracy within that world.

★Nasa (24)

Wada's colleague at Pizza Galaxy

A cashier whose customer service is textbook-level perfect.

Her impeccable attitude is so good it charms everyone, making her as popular as an idol.

Yet her “true colours” after work makes Wada suspect she's actually a delinquent.

★Eikichi (45)

Wada's colleague at Pizza Galaxy

A single father with a penchant for saving money works as both a waiter and an accountant.

Repeatedly suffers stomach issues and wastes money on medical treatment after bringing home expired foods meant for disposal from the cold storage, yet he never learns his lesson.

★Sonko (21)

A wota Wada met at the HSN57 fan offline meeting

A college student who always drifts outside conversations.

Never grasping the main point and often regarded as a suspicious character. 

With a passion for mecha anime and idols, he becomes entangled in the incident through a twist of fate involving a bottle of glue.

★Scien (20)

A wota Wada met at the HSN57 fan offline meeting

A programmer with a penchant for gaming, who once crushed Wada in the versus mode of LAWO.

She became an idol wota of HSN57 after falling for their singing voice, and uncovered a clue to the incident midway through the live concert.

★Editor (34)

Editor in charge of Wada

As an experienced media professional, she holds both high expectations and rigorous standards for Wada's novel.

She also passes on news about HSN57 overheard from the neighbouring editorial department to him.

As the incidents unfolded, she too began to take an interest in it.

★Manager (39)

The manager who occasionally appears at Pizza Galaxy

Due to his work, he often travels on business and only occasionally shows up at the shop.

A typical middle-aged office worker who enjoys listening to Eikichi recount the shop's happenings and takes pleasure in boasting to everyone about his daughter.

As the incidents unfolded, he too began to take an interest in it.

Other Information

The estimated playtime for a single playthrough is between 20 to 30 hours.

As the latest title in the MWLC series, the story timeline is set one year before the main story of MWLC.

But even if you haven't played MWLC, it won't affect your enjoyment of this title.

short_description: Play as an idol wota(otaku) and mystery novelist in this pixel world filled with various game memes and joyful daily life. Continuously improve your abilities and befriend wota friends with different attributes, working together to confront a conspiracy hidden within the idol wota world...
